value	Value	gV3DTickMS	gV3DTickMS	yes	yes			write: the game's own time between frames, 8 to 200 ms; empty = 33. Changes how often the player draws, never the 33 ms step.
value	Value	gNoMouse	gNoMouse	yes	yes			read: true while an AI tests. The game must not read, lock or move the mouse.

message	Game	Game.OnUpdate	Game.OnUpdate	no	yes			every 33 ms step while playing and not paused, after the engine has moved the objects and before it tests collisions.
message	Game	Game.OnStop	Game.OnStop	no	yes			when the game ends or the window closes.
message	Game	Game.OnPause	Game.OnPause	no	yes			when the game is paused.
